text:
maya: Heads up — seeing sustained enqueue on edge-fleet egress -> keystore proxy in us-west-2, GPU warm-pool nodes failing to finish provisioning.

deploy-bot: Alert: keystore-proxy queue length > 10000 for shard=us-west-2-edge at 4620001120 :rotating_light:

aj: Did we roll the new egress authz rules yesterday? I pushed tighter outbound rules to the edge subnets.

maya: Correlation looks strong. After the ACL tighten, a subset of nodes started hitting the public keystore fallback which is behind stricter rate limits, so retries are hammering the proxy.

sam: Logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts then immediate retries -> exponential backoff not taking effect quickly. Example logs:
```
Apr 20 12:05:43 keystore-proxy[pid]: conn=192.0.2.45 TLS handshake error: remote_closed
Apr 20 12:05:43 keystore-proxy[pid]: conn=192.0.2.45 retry=1 route=public-keystore
Apr 20 12:05:44 keystore-proxy[pid]: conn=192.0.2.45 retry=2 backoff=200ms
```

kevin: Impact on serving? Are models timing out or falling back to CPU?

maya: Warm-pool nodes can't finish bootstrap because KMS decrypts sometimes fail -> autoscaler keeps spinning up more nodes which then hit the same path. Net result: provisioning churn, GPU nodes idle while cost climbs.

aj: Quick mitigation: add privatelink route for keystore hosts in the edge VPC and exempt the warm-pool CIDR from the new egress deny rule. That should bypass the public fallback.

sam: Compliance note: that creates an exception to the tightened egress policy — audit logs will show a spike. We should gate it with a TTL and document the rationale. @kevin can you sign off on a temporary bypass for 2h?

kevin: +1 for 2 hours only, with audit entry and a rollback alarm. After change, restart warmpool and keystore-proxy.

maya: Making the change now: updating route table and egress ACL. Terraform snippet I'm applying:
```
resource "aws_route" "keystore_privatelink" {
  route_table_id = "rtb-0a1b2c"
  destination_cidr_block = "10.77.0.0/24" # keystore privatelink
  network_interface_id = "eni-0f123abc"
}
```

ops-bot: Config change detected: route-table rtb-0a1b2c updated, rule 103 added by aj at 4620001145 :white_check_mark:

aj: Restarting warmpool controller now -> `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/warmpool-controller`

deploy-bot: warmpool-controller: restart started, keystore-proxy: rolling restart queued

sam: Queue depth dropping, retries decaying, GPU utilization normalizing. Cost spike will persist for a little while but should settle.

maya: Agreed. Permanent fix proposal: 1) path-based bypass to privatelink for node agent+keystore traffic, 2) per-client rate limits in the keystore-proxy, 3) client-side better backoff and a health-check that fails fast to avoid long retry storms.

kevin: File an infra ticket with audit log exports and rollback instructions. Also run an eval of cold-start tail latency before/after.

aj: Created INFRA-9321, added audit note, TTL 2h on the exception, and a rollback CloudWatch alarm that triggers if keystore queue > 500 for 5m.

maya: Thanks — I'll attach cost impact numbers and next-steps for per-tenant throttling and a follow-up RFC.
